body_markdown:
**ST. PETERSBURG, Fla., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —** Superior Group of Companies, Inc. (NASDAQ: SGC) today announced its inclusion on Forbes’ 2027 America’s Best Companies list.


“We are honored to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Companies,” said Michael Benstock, Chief Executive Officer of Superior Group of Companies. “This recognition reflects the dedication and talent of our people across the organization, who work every day to deliver exceptional service, innovative solutions and lasting value to our customers. I’m proud of what our teams have accomplished together and excited about the opportunities ahead.”


Forbes’ 2027 America’s Best Companies ranking evaluates U.S. companies across a comprehensive range of measures, including financial performance, employee and customer sentiment, innovation, cybersecurity, sustainability and workforce stability. The assessment draws on data from independent research providers like Dun & Bradstreet, to evaluate overall company quality.


**About Superior Group of Companies, Inc. (SGC):**
Established in 1920, Superior Group of Companies is comprised of three attractive business segments each serving large, fragmented and growing addressable markets. Across Healthcare Apparel, Branded Products and Contact Centers, each segment enables businesses to create extraordinary brand engagement experiences for their customers and employees. SGC’s commitment to service, quality, advanced technology, and omnichannel commerce provides unparalleled competitive advantages. We are committed to enhancing shareholder value by continuing to pursue a combination of organic growth and strategic acquisitions.
